conventions.rank_ic: Pearson correlation of average ranks within each prediction timestamp, averaged equally over timestamps per day
conventions.ic: Pearson correlation of score and target within each timestamp, averaged equally over timestamps per day
conventions.turnover: 0.5*sum(abs(net_weight_t-net_weight_previous)) between consecutive sampled timestamps including overnight; first section undefined
conventions.long_short_return: equal-weight top/bottom 20% gross forward return spread; no fees, execution, overlap or compounding
conventions.official_score: not implemented; local approximate metrics only
